title: 在美国餐厅结账：要账单、给小费英语怎么说？
summary: 美国餐厅不会主动拿账单来，一定要你开口要。这篇教你结账、分开买单的说法，以及小费给多少的规矩。

featuredPhrase.en: Can I get the check, please?

phrases.en: Can I get the check, please?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.en: Excuse me, can I get the check, please?

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.en: Sure! Here you go. That'll be $52.80.
dialogue.zh: 好的！给你。一共 52.8 美元。

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.en: Can we split the bill? Two cards.
dialogue.zh: 能分开买单吗？刷两张卡。

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.en: No problem. I'll split it evenly.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.en: Great. And the tip — 20% is okay, right?
dialogue.zh: 太好了。小费——给 20% 可以吧？

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.en: That's perfect. Thank you so much!
